create_ClassyBlock: create a ClassyBlock instance wrapping a PyTorch module with a given name
build_ClassyBlock_forward: build a forward pass through a ClassyBlock that records the wrapped module output
test_ClassyBlock_wrapped_module: test the wrapped_module method to retrieve the underlying PyTorch module from a ClassyBlock
review_ClassyBlock_stateless: review the ClassyBlock stateless mode controlled by the CLASSY_BLOCK_STATELESS environment variable
summarize_ClassyBlock: summarize the ClassyBlock class which wraps a module and records its output for head execution
